description: This file implements a singly linked list data structure with basic operations such as add, remove, get, and size.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list class providing methods to add, remove, retrieve elements by index, and determine the size of the list.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node in the linked list, containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method to find the last node of the list starting from the head.
